title: Senior Civil Estimator (Earthwork & Utilities)
summary: We are seeking a highly capable Senior Civil Estimator to take full ownership of the estimating function and manage the entire bidding process from start to finish.
requirements: Job Title: Senior Civil Estimator (Earthwork & Utilities)
Working Hours: Monday to Friday, standard U.S. Mountain Time business hours

The successful candidate will gradually transition from working under review and oversight to independently managing the complete estimating lifecycle and delivering client-ready proposals with minimal supervision

This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced estimator who thrives in a lean environment, enjoys ownership and accountability, and is comfortable operating independently within established systems and procedures
Manage the complete estimating process for commercial earthwork and utility construction projects from bid invitation through proposal submission
Develop complete project estimates and bid proposals

title: Director of Strategic Partnerships, Growth (Remote)
summary: We believe that mental health is just as important as physical health. We recognize that mental health issues can be complex and multifaceted, and we are dedicated to treating the whole person, not just the symptoms.
requirements: 10+ years of healthcare business development or quota-carrying sales experience
5+ years managing complex, long-cycle strategic sales processes
Deep knowledge of the U.S. healthcare ecosystem and funds flow, particularly regarding health plans, EAPs, and self-insured employers
Proven ability to engage C-suite healthcare executives, driving end-to-end deal origination, outreach, and discovery
Direct experience in B2B behavioral health, mental health solutions, or digital health business development
An active network of senior decision-makers and C-suite relationships within major health plans and payor organizations

title: Senior Technical Recruiter, Robotics
summary: AeroVect is transforming ground handling with autonomy, redefining how airlines and ground service providers around the globe run day-to-day operations.
requirements: Partner closely with AeroVect’s founders, engineering leaders, and principal recruiter to understand hiring objectives and align sourcing strategies
Contribute to delivering a high-quality and holistic candidate experience
Use innovative sourcing techniques to attract top talent (e.g. networking, events, marketing, etc.)
5+ years of recruiting experience, with a strong emphasis on sourcing and finding creative ways to attract talent
Experience with Ashby, Greenhouse, Lever, or other ATS
Experience with fast growing and quick scaling start-ups

title: Senior Mechanical & Plumbing Estimator
summary: Our client is a growing construction services company based in the Orlando, Florida area, specializing in HVAC, plumbing, and mechanical systems for complex commercial projects.
requirements: Working Hours: Flexible, aligned with the U.S. Eastern Time business hours as needed

The ideal candidate has strong experience working on complex mechanical and plumbing systems such as hospitals, chilled water systems, and large commercial projects requiring detailed plan and specification review
Manage estimated revisions and support ongoing preconstruction activities
Participate in daily workflows, meetings, and systems as a fully integrated member of the team
Civil Engineering degree or equivalent construction estimating experience
Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal

title: Regional Director, Fairfield County
summary: We're looking for a Regional Director based in Fairfield County, CT to serve our Connecticut and Westchester members.
requirements: Every region/city is unique. You'll get to know the members in your region and understand how the 3i network can best help them achieve their investment, personal, philanthropic, business and career goals
Manage the onboarding process for new members to ensure that they're thoughtfully integrated into the 3i community and can immediately leverage the power of the organization
Ensure members have a positive experience such that they renew their memberships
Drive the growth strategy for how you will invest in the growth of the 3i network within your region
We are a referral-only network so you'll need to be comfortable thoughtfully requesting, qualifying and engaging with referrals from your members
You'll build relationships with some of the most interesting and prominent people who live in your region

title: Senior Hardware Field Engineer
summary: AeroVect is transforming ground handling with autonomy, redefining how airlines and ground service providers around the globe run day-to-day operations.
requirements: Develop and refine hardware inspection checklists, labeling standards, and post-repair verification procedures
Coordinate with procurement to manage local spare parts inventory and ensure critical components are stocked at the deployment site
3+ years of hands-on experience in hardware field engineering, electromechanical systems, vehicle electronics, robotics or a closely related discipline
Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and repair both mechanical systems and electrical systems, including wiring harnesses, vehicle power systems and connectors
Experience reading and working from wiring diagrams, vehicle schematics and mechanical drawings
Comfort working independently in a field environment — scheduling your own work, prioritizing across multiple open issues and communicating status clearly to remote stakeholders

title: Senior Enterprise Account Executive, DACH
summary: Our EMEA Enterprise sales team is looking to add a Senior Enterprise Account Executive to the team with knowledge of technology and solid business-to-business sales.
requirements: Establish and develop a strategy for identifying and closing net new sales opportunities
Prospect into targeted strategic accounts within designated territory
Develop and implement in-territory or vertically-focused field marketing campaigns
Present and sell directly to C-level executives within but not limited to HR, Legal, Finance, Procurement and Travel Management
Collaborate and lead successful execution of sales activities through contract negotiation and signed contracts with internal and external teams
Manage all sales activity and monthly forecasting of revenue in Salesforce
